value.rationale: The complete fourth-level random monic cubic root-count distribution is a natural exact invariant of singular Hensel lifting. It includes every coefficient stratum and the rare 3p² clustering event, beyond previous expected-value, p-adic-root, and p³ results. The double and triple branch interactions at the first fourth level give genuinely additional mass categories and an explicit sharp extremizer census.
